summary: The AWS Big Data Engineer develops, deploys, and manages scalable data solutions using AWS managed services for analytics, ETL, and data warehousing.
responsibilities: Build big data pipelines using AWS services (EMR, Glue, Redshift, Kinesis)
Optimize storage, compute, and data processing performance
Implement ETL/ELT workflows in AWS environments
Monitor data pipelines and ensure reliability and fault tolerance
Implement cloud security best practices and IAM policies

education: 3–6 years of experience with AWS big data solutions

skills_required.name: Expertise in AWS big data services (EMR, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena)
Programming in Python, Java, or Scala
Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure and deployment
